description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for managing holidays within an organization, including creating, activating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and listing holidays. It uses JAX-RS annotations for REST endpoints, Swagger annotations for API documentation, and depends on various services and serializers for processing requests and responses.

classes.name: HolidaysApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class for holiday management endpoints, handling CRUD operations, activation, and listing of holidays.

methods.name: createNewHoliday
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new holiday with provided details.

methods.name: handleCommands
methods.description: Handles POST requests to activate a holiday based on holidayId and command parameter.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve details of a specific holiday by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing holiday's details.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to mark a holiday as deleted.

methods.name: retrieveAllHolidays
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all holidays based on search parameters.

methods.name: retrieveRepaymentScheduleUpdationTyeOptions
methods.description: Provides options for repayment schedule update types.
